title: WooCommerce Read-Only MCP Tool Specification
description: MCP tool specification for the WooCommerce Agent Studio private connector.

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Check that the WooCommerce store URL and REST API credentials work. Returns connectivity status and total order count.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List orders with newest orders first. Supports filtering by status, date range, or customer ID, with pagination metadata.

status.description: Filter by order status: pending, processing, on-hold, completed, cancelled, refunded, failed.

after.description: ISO 8601 datetime to filter orders created after this timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00).

before.description: ISO 8601 datetime to filter orders created before this timestamp.

per_page.description: Number of orders to retrieve per page (1-100).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Retrieve details of a single order by its numeric ID, including line items and status.

order_id.description: The unique numeric ID of the WooCommerce order.

tools.name: search_orders
tools.description: Search orders by free text matching against order number, customer name, customer email, or product title.

per_page.description: Number of orders to retrieve per page (1-100).

error_codes.auth_failed: HTTP 401/403: Invalid credentials or insufficient permissions.
error_codes.not_found: HTTP 404: The requested order or resource was not found.
error_codes.rate_limited: HTTP 429: Rate limit exceeded and max backoff retries exhausted.
error_codes.unavailable: HTTP 5xx or connection/timeout error persisting after retries.
error_codes.woo_error: Unexpected WooCommerce API or client error.
